25K likes, 325 comments - aman on September 11, 2026: "Meet pressure with presence. This December, Aman Global Ambassador and Wellness Advisor Novak Djokovic hosts Stillness and Strength: A Novak Djokovic Retreat at @amanjena. The intimate three-day programme will explore the practices behind his approach to performance, from tennis masterclasses and meditation to breathwork and restorative rituals.
 
18-20 December 2026. Limited spaces available.

Discover more and register your interest via the link in bio.".
